Sena minister meets CJP founder's parents, promises security

Sena minister Sanjay Shirsat met the parents of Abhijeet Dipke, the founder of the Centre for the Study of Law and Governance (CJP), in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. The meeting was described as a gesture of goodwill by the government. The CJP has been critical of the Shiv Sena-led government in Maharashtra. Sanjay Shirsat promised to ensure security for Dipke's parents during the meeting.
